authorized_restart.reason: Externally stopped by user; original ARW recovery refused unknown state.
authorized_restart.effective_metrics_scope: New attempt only; old raw evidence preserved.

formal_completion.reason: The Reviewer final message does not follow the status-only contract.

rows.aggregation_scope: Arithmetic mean of original ARW diagnostic repetition scores: user-authorized retry 1 and original repetitions 2/3; not a newly completed formal ARW batch.

method: Frozen original ARW score-completed, original F2 and native three-repeat arithmetic means. Initial report only; Main repairs representation in separate copies; all Reviewer followup outputs and costs excluded.
performance_scope: Spec Readiness scores fuse both original subscenarios, but performance reports artifact-promotion only, per user instruction.
token_scope: Every actual internal generation pass: sum original engine read/reused/generated counters, including expanded continuation prompts. Initial phase only, Reviewer plus guardian. Model output excludes injected wrap tokens that were not generated. Never use API usage as consumption values.
formal_scope: All new scores are diagnostic; original first-delivery format failures, incomplete/timeout and native gate failures remain. No release or convergence authorization.
interruption_scope: Prior explicit user authorization still excludes externally stopped artifact-promotion attempt and uses its independently restarted effective initial attempt. Raw interrupted history and cost remain archived; this is separate from output correction.
conditions: 14 pre-prevention and 16 with startup prevention observations retained and labelled. Results do not establish isolated profile causality or equivalence across startup cohorts.
history_policy: Prior scoring and inclusive cost reports are retained; this is a new first-delivery-only calculation, not an overwrite.
display: Current report only: minutes with one decimal; score and USD equivalent cost with three decimals; tokens decimal K integer part. Full precision retained before aggregation.
equivalent_cost_formula: USD equivalent = (uncached_input * 0.15 + cached_input * 0.016 + output * 0.47) / 1000000. Raw counts; not an actual bill.
retry_scope: Only trained Commit Audit repetition 1 replaced by explicitly authorized new attempt; original timeout and zero score preserved as superseded history.

raw_evidence_retention.scope: Old-version temporary run/session/log evidence in project and installation; old installation rollback backups and unused publication mirrors.
